biggest_catch: Long wait: the bonus is not paid until the 90-day qualification period ends, plus up to 30 calendar days — roughly 4 months after opening. No published expiry, but the offer can be discontinued at any time without notice.
catches: Recurring direct deposit required at least once per month (no minimum dollar amount published for the bonus itself).
Enrollment in e-Statements is required within 60 days of account opening.

Account must remain open and in good standing for at least 90 days; bonus is deposited within 30 calendar days after the 90-day qualification period ends (account must still be open when the bonus is attempted).
The promotion has no stated end date: 'The bonus is available for this promotion unless and until Metro CU has discontinued the promotion.'
Metro Credit Union is a Massachusetts-based credit union (Chelsea, MA); membership eligibility and geography apply — not nationwide.
No monthly service charge or minimum balance on Metro Checking.
Tax treatment is not disclosed on the offer page; bank bonuses are generally reported as interest and may be taxable.
